messages:
maya: quick QA from mobile testing: modal close 'X' on the dataset preview is hard to hit when keyboard is up. It's only 28px across. anyone else see this? (attached screenshot: modal-close-touch.png)

lina: saw that too. on small screens the header compresses. i think we should standardize on a 44px touch target for all interactive chrome, not just buttons.

jorge: agreed. if we expand the hit area via an invisible padding box we won't affect visual layout. e.g.:
```
.close-btn { position: relative; }
.close-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; }
```
but watch stacking context so the pseudo doesn't block other elements.

sam: one extra thing: the toast system currently stacks up to 5, then drops oldest. customers reported confusing behavior where an important error disappears behind new success toasts. Can we change priority so errors persist longer and success toasts are transient?

lina: good call. suggest priority levels: error > warning > info > success. rules: errors stay 12s or until dismissed, success 4s. also add a 'sticky' flag for API-driven critical alerts.

maya: that works. for animations — I prefer staggered fade with slight upward motion so new toasts don't overlap abruptly. keep motion subtle.

design-bot: accessibility check: increasing hit targets to 44px meets touch target guideline. Tooltip behavior: ensure toasts expose aria-live="polite" for non-critical, aria-live="assertive" for errors. Contrast: the ghost primary button (white bg, subtle border) fails 3:1 on some low-vision themes.

jorge: on the ghost/primary combo — maybe add `button.ghost--focus` state that increases border thickness or adds a faint ring to meet 3:1. example: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(var(--primary-rgb), .12); border-width: 1.5px;`

maya: i want us to also rename spacing tokens. current tokens `spacing.small`, `spacing.medium` are ambiguous for lists & cards. proposal: `spacing.row-compact`, `spacing.row-default`, `spacing.card-sm`, `spacing.card-md`. this makes intent clearer to devs and helps design token audits.

sam: rename is fine, but we have to migrate components. add backwards-compat shims in CSS variables for a release cycle.

lina: i'll update figma symbols and add a short migration doc in the component library README.

maya: plan: 1) implement invisible hit-area for modal close and add .touch-target utility; 2) toast priority + timing changes + aria-live updates; 3) ghost button contrast tweaks on focus; 4) token rename + migration shim. i'll open design PR with screenshots tonight.

jorge: i'll follow up with a tiny dev PR for the pseudo-element approach so QA can test.

design-bot: reminder: add unit test to toast queue logic for priority behaviors and update CHANGELOG under "component-library".

maya: awesome, thanks team. will post Figma links when ready. :raised_hands:
